digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verifier, close precheck
propositions: An AC tagged [operator-attested] with in-repository code-verifiable evidence (exact path/symbol citation) passes plan-review close gates despite carrying no provenance: continuation line, because evidence-kind LLM judgment failed and det_measurement_provenance is wired as advisory only

The completion verifier accepts tagged ACs at face value per ADR-0043 design, making the plan-review evidence-kind guard and provenance check the sole rejection points; both failed on epic fb8a-7363-e406-4e36 before close

A deterministic pre-LLM close-path guard must block [operator-attested] ACs whose own text cites exact repository paths/symbols (tests/, src/, pytest ::node ids, code-extension paths) without a valid provenance: line, rejecting the attestation-laundering pattern before completion

The plan-review guard det_attestation_launder.py must distinguish evidence citations (inherently proof) from orientation citations (mere context) using evidence-introducing keywords, and never fire on commit SHAs or Gerrit numbers per ADR-0043 attestation scope

Mixed-evidence ACs (both repository paths and external outcomes) must split: code-verifiable portions untag; external portions retain [operator-attested] with provenance, coaching the author before close
Retag edits on [operator-attested] ACs must stale the signed plan-review attestation, forcing re-review to prevent post-certification laundering escape
